name: Brown Sugar
siboNotes: Pure brown sugar is FODMAP-free but feeds gut bacteria; use sparingly and consider timing with meals to minimize bacterial fermentation.
preparationTips: Store in airtight container to prevent hardening
If hardened, place a slice of bread in container overnight to soften
Dark brown sugar has stronger molasses flavor than light brown
Can substitute 1:1 for white sugar in most recipes
nutritionalHighlights: Small amounts of potassium and calcium
